description: This file contains a static utility class 'SyntaxFactoryUtility' for generating and manipulating C# syntax nodes using the Roslyn API, specifically for constructing member access expressions and handling generic type parameters and constraints.

classes.name: SyntaxFactoryUtility
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to generate C# syntax nodes for member access, generic names, and adding type parameter constraints using Roslyn APIs.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string)
methods.description: Returns a member access expression given an instance expression and a member name as string.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, IdentifierNameSyntax)
methods.description: Returns a member access expression for a given instance expression and a member represented as an IdentifierNameSyntax.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, GenericNameSyntax)
methods.description: Returns a member access expression for a given instance expression and a generic member name.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string, params TypeSyntax[])
methods.description: Returns a member access expression with optional generic type arguments.

methods.name: ToGenericName (string)
methods.description: Converts a string identifier into a GenericNameSyntax object.

methods.name: AddGenericTypeParameters (ClassDeclarationSyntax, List<...>)
methods.description: Adds generic type parameters and constraints to a class declaration syntax node.

methods.name: GetTypeParameterConstraints (List<...>)
methods.description: Builds a list of constraints for each type parameter based on the ITypeParameterSymbol properties.
